# sartawi.dev

> Personal site of Mohammad Salah (Mo), a 15-year-old Full Stack Developer based in Ras Al Khaimah, UAE.

## About

- [Mohammad Salah](https://sartawi.dev): Full Stack Developer focused on TypeScript, Next.js, and Go.
- Contact: [me@sartawi.dev](mailto:me@sartawi.dev)

## Projects

- [untap](https://github.com/mnsartawi/untap): personal project by Mohammad Salah.
- [clak](https://github.com/mnsartawi/clak): mechanical keyboard sounds emulator app built with Tauri.
- [cdn](https://cdn.sartawi.dev): personal asset CDN.
- [quranbuddy](https://qb.sartawi.dev): Quran companion app.
- [38-0](http://discord.gg/realsports): Discord bot for the RFL community, based on the 38-0 Premier League game.

## Elsewhere

- [GitHub](https://github.com/mnsartawi): code and open-source projects.
- [Instagram](https://instagram.com/v7xmhd): personal profile.
- [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@m.s7v): short videos.
- [Discord](https://discord.com/users/718185533460840450): direct messages.

## Site

- Built with [Next.js](https://nextjs.org), [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com), [shadcn/ui](https://ui.shadcn.com), and [Framer Motion](https://motion.dev).
- Features a theme toggle, a Quran audio player, live coding-activity presence, and a GitHub contributions graph.
- Source code: [sartawi.dev on GitHub](https://github.com/mnsartawi/sartawi.dev).
